names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 13 mai, «Sfântul Cuvios Ioan Ivirul».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 13 Μαΐου, «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Ίβηρας», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's third heading for the Julian 13 May, „Преподобни Јован, Јевтимије Георгије и Гаврил Иверски.“ — Преподобни left off, which is the `venerable` this folder already carries in `types`, and **Иверски kept**, which is not a rank but the epithet "the Iberian" that the heading sets after all four names and that the entry's first sentence confirms belongs to all four, they being the founders of the Iberian monastery. **Reading it as distributing over the four is this day's naming decision, and the alternative was measured**: bare forenames would have put «Јован» into a fold of **eight** folders, «Јевтимије» into one with `euthymius-of-dimitsana` and «Георгије» into one with `george-of-mytilene`, where all four kept forms fold with nothing at all. The Romanian forms on these folders already carry the epithet — «Ioan Ivirul», «Eftimie Ivirul», «Gheorghe Ivirul», «Gavriil Ivirul» — where the Greek ones do not, so the fuller reading is the one two calendars support. BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §6's "one form, the fullest" decides it. Athanasius's lavra and the 998 are in the body.

Name page 1013 is «Иоанн Святогорец, Иверский (Афонский), прп.»; the rank is stripped and the rest kept whole, parentheses and all. The day line declines the two of them together as «Иоанна … и Гавриила … Святогорцев».

death.note: The first date this folder has carried. The Ohrid Prologue, for the Julian 13 May: „Упокојио се 998. године.“ Neither doxologia.ro's line for 13 mai nor saint.gr's gave him any year, although the same two pages dated his companions — Euthymius 1028, George 1066, Gabriel 1028 — and this book agrees exactly with the first two of those three. No birth is printed.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 12 июля ст. ст. — «Прпп. Иоанна (998) (Груз.) и Гавриила (X) (Груз.) Святогорцев.»

attestations.note: The day's fifth entry, two Georgians on one line and both folders already held. Name page 1013 is «Иоанн Святогорец, Иверский (Афонский), прп.» and the reading life6627 identifies him beyond doubt: father of Euthymius the New of Athos, founder and abbot of the Iviron house on Athos, reposed 14 January 998 — the 998 this folder already carries, off the Ohrid Prologue, and the Euthymius its `related` already names. The folder's other three rows stand on the Julian 13 May with the other founders; this row stands on the 12 July the day page gives, one row per church and nothing moved. `dates` unchanged. The reading adds a day, 14 January, which this day page does not repeat; it is recorded here and not made a feast. No hymn on the day page under his name.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 13 mai — «Sfântul Cuvios Ioan Ivirul»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης ο Ίβηρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same civil day the Romanian calendar already keeps him on, and it is plainly the same man: John Varasvatse, founder of Iviron, father of Euthymius. **He is none of the corpus's very many other Johns**, which the namesweep flagged and which were read; the surname the page gives him, and the son, settle it. **The Greek adds his lay offices and the years of his death**: counsellor to David Kouropalates, governor of Iberia, toparch of Iberian Meskhia and a title-holder of Byzantium, and «Κοιμήθηκε με ειρήνη μεταξύ των ετών 998-1003 μ.Χ.» — asleep in peace between 998 and 1003, which Euthymius's page on the same day repeats as «Το 998 μ.Χ. (κατ' άλλους το 1003 μ.Χ.)». The folder carries no `dates` object and is not given one here; the bracket stands in this note and in the added paragraph. **It adds a stage the corpus may not hold**: before the Holy Mountain he withdrew to Olympus in Mysia, and he went to Athos only after fetching from Constantinople his young son Euthymius, who had been handed over as a hostage by David of Iberia. **Two men are linked**, his son [Euthymius](/saints/euthymius-the-iberian) and [Athanasius the Athonite](/saints/athanasius-the-athonite), in whose Lavra he practised asceticism with some disciples. No hymn is printed.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 26.05.2026 (13. мај ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Јован, Јевтимије Георгије и Гаврил Иверски.“

attestations.note: The day's third entry, an enumerated company of four, so one row each, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek keep all four on, so nothing moved. The heading's missing comma between Јевтимије and Георгије is the book's and is quoted as printed. **A FIRST DATE FOR A FOLDER THAT HELD NONE**: „Свети Јован подвизавао се најпре у Атанасијевој лаври, потом основао свој манастир, Ивер. Упокојио се 998. године.“ → `death` 998, where this folder had no `dates` object at all; neither doxologia's line nor saint.gr's gave him a year, although both gave his three companions theirs. **New here**: that he struggled first **in the lavra of Athanasius** and only then founded his own monastery, Iver. **`athanasius-the-athonite` was already a `related` row** on this folder and is linked in the appended paragraph; nothing was added to him. **`related_add: ["gabriel-the-iberian"]`**, who is the one of the four this folder did not carry and whom the heading enumerates beside it; the reciprocal is in the same file. `types` untouched: Преподобни is the `venerable` the folder carries, and founding and governing a monastery is the `abbot` it carries too. **No `locations`**: the Holy Mountain is named and this folder has never claimed a point. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
